description: Enable AI assistants to search hotels, manage bookings, and access hotel data seamlessly through the Medici Hotels API. Simplify hotel price searches, room management, and booking operations with secure JWT authentication. Enhance your travel or hospitality applications with real-time hotel booking capabilities.
